candidate.selection_reason: observable input 'url' -> exact operation 'replace(.., '')' -> security-sensitive effect of potentially allowing directory traversal by only removing one instance of '..' per loop iteration instead of all instances

target_cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that should be within a restricted directory, but it does not properly neutralize sequences such as .. that can resolve to a location that is outside of that directory. Common in: path_traversal, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Validate and sanitize all file paths and names
Use canonical path resolution and access controls

stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: The code allows relative paths to be manipulated via URL input, which can lead to accessing unexpected resources.
